statement: (∀ i j k l : Idx lam, latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j) * latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y k l) = if j = k then (coeff lam j : ℤ) • latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i l) else 0) ∧ (∑ i : Idx lam, (coeffOmit lam i : ℤ) • latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i i)) = (coeffProd lam : ℤ) • (1 : Module.End ℤ M)
proof:
classical
have hr := @yui_aux_0002 p K instK lam V instV instCV x y h v M h_T001 h_H005 h_H006
have hs := (@yui_aux_0005 p K instK lam V instV instCV x y h v M h_T001 h_H005 h_H006).2.2.2.2.2
have ha := @yui_aux_0004 p K instK lam V instV instCV x y h v M h_T001 h_H005 h_H006
constructor
· intro i j k l
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  apply Subtype.ext
  have he := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℂ V => f (m : V)) (ha.2.1 i j k l)
  by_cases hjk : j = k
  · simpa only [hjk, if_true, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, hr _ (hs _ _)] using he
  · simpa only [hjk, if_false, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, hr _ (hs _ _)] using he
· apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  apply Subtype.ext
  have he := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℂ V => f (m : V)) ha.2.2
  simpa only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul, hr _ (hs _ _), Module.End.one_apply] using he

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (K : Type u_1) [instK : Field K] (lam : ℤ) (V : Type u_2) [instV : AddCommGroup V]
  [instCV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  (↑(ell lam) = lam ∧
      0 < ell lam + 1 ∧
        (∃ b, ∀ (i : Idx lam), b i = ev y v ↑i) ∧
          (∀ (r : ℕ), ell lam < r → (y ^ r) v = 0) ∧
            x (ev y v 0) = 0 ∧
              (∀ (i : Idx lam), 0 < ↑i → x (ev y v ↑i) = ↑(ell lam - ↑i + 1) • ev y v (↑i - 1)) ∧
                (∀ (i : Idx lam), ↑i < ell lam → y (ev y v ↑i) = ↑(↑i + 1) • ev y v (↑i + 1)) ∧
                  y (ev y v (ell lam)) = 0 ∧
                    (∀ (i : Idx lam), h (ev y v ↑i) = (↑(ell lam) - 2 * ↑↑i) • ev y v ↑i) ∧
                      (∀ (r : ℕ) (i : Idx lam),
                          (dividedPower x r) (ev y v ↑i) =
                            if r ≤ ↑i then ↑((ell lam - ↑i + r).choose r) • ev y v (↑i - r) else 0) ∧
                        ∀ (r : ℕ) (i : Idx lam),
                          (dividedPower y r) (ev y v ↑i) =
                            if ↑i + r ≤ ell lam then ↑((↑i + r).choose r) • ev y v (↑i + r) else 0) →
    v ≠ 0 ∧ x v = 0 ∧ h v = ↑lam • v ∧ h * x - x * h = 2 • x ∧ h * y - y * h = -2 • y ∧ x * y - y * x = h →
      admissibleLattice (ell lam) x y M →
        (∀ (i j k l : Idx lam),
            latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j) * latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y k l) =
              if j = k then ↑(coeff lam j) • latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i l) else 0) ∧
          ∑ i, ↑(coeffOmit lam i) • latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i i) = ↑(coeffProd lam) • 1
